form: A muddy, reed-fringed shore at the edge of the pool, open to the sky, with no built structure: the dream's version of the backwater bank, where a rough circle is trampled into the grass for the Caucus-race

grows_from.waking_detail: the muddy, reed-fringed edge of the river backwater beside the bank

mucha_design_language.item: Mucha / Art Nouveau carried by the waterside planting: yellow flag irises and white water-lilies (native English, Mucha's own motifs) massed along the waterline in flowing drifts; reeds and reedmace leaning in long whiplash curves; the fallen willow trunk's grain and limbs sweeping in organic S-curves; the scuffed race-circle reading as a round halo roundel from above; pastel-and-gold palette of iris yellow, lily white, sage and pale sky; no built ornament (the text gives no structure)
mucha_design_language.why: Dream environment; the text's shore has no buildings, so the language is expressed in real living flora

structure.item: a gently sloping shore of mud and flattened grass rising from the waterline to a level grassy flat about 20 m across
a rough circle about 10 m across, scuffed into the grass and marked with a few sticks, the Caucus-race course
structure.note: 'a race-course, in a sort of circle'; sticks inferred

structure.item: the waterline of the pool along one side of the plan, still water with no far shore visible
the edge of a dense wood on the landward side (exit toward SCN-wonderland-wood area in ch004)
structure.note: geography.json LOC-thick-wood is 'close to the pool-bank'

materials.item: wet dark mud trampled with footprints at the water edge
flattened meadow grass with daisies and buttercups (the same flowers as the waking bank)
materials.why: The dream shore grows from the waking bank

materials.item: tall reed beds and reedmace along the water

details.item: a single fallen willow trunk lying along the shore, used as a seat for the Mouse's lecture
details.why: Gives the party a raised speaking place and the plan a fixed landmark; grows from the waking willow

scale_notes.anchor: Alice is still small after the pool. The party (Mouse, Dodo, Duck, Lory, Eaglet and the other birds and beasts) and the White Rabbit are photoreal CGI animals (SUP-002 as amended BIB-0027) at the sizes set by 04-creatures relative to Alice.

builds.beat: assembly, lecture, Caucus-race, the Mouse's tale, the White Rabbit's return
builds.build: 1:1 ground with oversized x4 reed beds (6 to 8 m tall) and oversized daisy, buttercup and flag-iris heads near camera, so the true-size Alice reads small; the CGI animals are composited to match

scale_notes.rule: No hall walls, doors or lamps remain; the hall has vanished completely (ch004-p01, SUP-013).

negative: no hall, doors, stone walls or lamps
no sea, sand beach, waves, pier or boats
no cartoon animals, no humans in animal costume; the party are photoreal CGI animals
no flat poster illustration, outline graphics or matte-painting finish
prompt_ready_en: a muddy reed-fringed shore at the edge of a still pool under an open summer sky, trampled footprints in wet mud, flattened meadow grass with daisies and buttercups, drifts of yellow flag irises and white water-lilies along the water in flowing Art Nouveau lines after Mucha, very tall reed beds leaning in long whiplash curves, a fallen willow trunk along the shore, a rough circle scuffed into the grass marked with a few sticks, the edge of a dense wood behind, soft pastel-and-gold light, photographed live-action
